actions.action: Dab a white spot with a cotton swab to check whether it is mealybugs or fungus/wax
Isolate the plant away from other plants
Wash hands and tools after handling the plant
Dab each cottony spot with a swab dipped in 70% isopropyl alcohol
Snip off badly infested stems and discard them in a sealed bag
Spray stems, leaf undersides and soil surface with insecticidal soap or neem oil every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Once clear, unpot, rinse old soil, check roots and repot into fresh well-draining mix in a clean pot
Watch for new colonies for a few weeks

reason: The answer identifies mealybugs as the main cause and leads with 70% alcohol treatment, which matches the fix that worked; its extra steps are reasonable and not harmful.
